entities.name: Noyan Dar
entities.description: A merfolk lullmage of Zendikar, founder and leader of Coralhelm Refuge, able to control the Roil.

entities.name: Zendikar
entities.description: The plane where Noyan Dar lives.

entities.name: Roil
entities.description: The dangerous, terrain-altering force that lullmages suppress and control.

entities.name: Coralhelm Refuge
entities.description: Refuge founded by Noyan Dar for merfolk refugees upriver.

entities.name: Sea Gate
entities.description: City where Noyan Dar was born; it fell to the Eldrazi spawn.

entities.name: Enclave
entities.description: Merfolk Enclave where Noyan Dar studied and built a network of supporters.

entities.name: Thada Adel
entities.description: Merfolk leader of the Tikal Harborage and Noyan Dar's greatest enemy.

entities.name: Gideon Jura
entities.description: Planeswalker who visited Noyan Dar to gain his allegiance and tricked him into joining.

entities.name: Cosi
entities.description: Merfolk trickster god in the stories.

entities.name: Ula
entities.description: Merfolk god who was tricked by Cosi.

entities.name: Eldrazi
entities.description: The titans and spawn that overran Zendikar.

entities.name: Ulamog
entities.description: Eldrazi titan whose brood was driven from Sea Gate.

entities.name: Kozilek
entities.description: Eldrazi titan awakened by Ob Nixilis.

entities.name: Battle for Zendikar
entities.description: War in which Sea Gate and the Enclave fell to the Eldrazi.

entities.name: Liberation of Sea Gate
entities.description: Battle in which Noyan Dar and his students helped drive off Ulamog's brood.

events.summary: Sea Gate and the Enclave fall to the Eldrazi spawn and Noyan Dar leads refugees upriver to found Coralhelm Refuge.
events.quote: he led refugees from the Enclave farther upriver to found Coralhelm Refuge

events.summary: Gideon Jura visits Noyan Dar, flatters him, and wins his agreement to join the army.
Noyan Dar realizes Gideon tricked him as Cosi tricked Ula.
events.quote: Gideon had tricked him just as Cosi tricked Ula

events.summary: Noyan Dar and his students take part in the Liberation of Sea Gate and drive off Ulamog's brood.
events.quote: helped in driving off Ulamog 's brood

events.summary: After Kozilek's awakening Noyan Dar is the last roil mage standing and survives Zendikar's Last Stand.
events.quote: Dar was the last roil mage standing

relations.quote: Noyan Dar's greatest enemy is someone who shares his goals as well as his skills: Thada Adel
Noyan Dar, the founder and the leader of Coralhelm Refuge
